name: 10510 · Briarcliff, NY
findings: ZIP 10510 (Briarcliff) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10510 (Briarcliff) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10510 (Briarcliff) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
